note: The vendored Konva surface for the Canvas tab: ONE self-contained UMD browser build and the MIT text that covers it, taken out of the pinned npm tarball. Nothing is forked and nothing is patched - the only mechanical change is CRLF-to-LF with one trailing newline, because .gitattributes stores text as LF and these bytes are hashed, so a CRLF-hashed file would report phantom drift on every clean checkout. `--check` re-hashes both files OFFLINE from this record; the tarball itself is verified against the registry’s published sha512 before a byte is extracted.

konva.min.js.note: upstream’s own UMD browser build: one self-contained file that leaves `globalThis.Konva` behind
